mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_plan ( title, description, user_no, start_day, end_day, updated_at, total_member ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{userNo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, NOW(), #{totalMember} )

INSERT INTO my_daily_plan ( visited_date, start_time, end_time, move_time, attraction_title, attraction_thumbnail, attraction_latitude, attraction_longitude, attraction_rating, memo, attraction_no, my_plan_no ) VALUES ( #{visitedDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{moveTime}, #{attractionTitle}, #{attractionThumbnail}, #{attractionLatitude}, #{attractionLongitude}, #{attractionRating}, #{memo}, #{attractionNo}, #{myPlanNo} )

INSERT INTO my_daily_plan ( visited_date, start_time, end_time, move_time, attraction_title, attraction_thumbnail, attraction_latitude, attraction_longitude, attraction_rating, memo, attraction_no, my_plan_no ) VALUES
( #{plan.visitedDate}, #{plan.startTime}, #{plan.endTime}, #{plan.moveTime}, #{plan.attractionTitle}, #{plan.attractionThumbnail}, #{plan.attractionLatitude}, #{plan.attractionLongitude}, #{plan.attractionRating}, #{plan.memo}, #{plan.attractionNo}, #{plan.myPlanNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT no, title, description, user_no, start_day, end_day, updated_at, total_member FROM my_plan WHERE user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT no, title, description, user_no, start_day, end_day, updated_at, total_member FROM my_plan WHERE no = #{planNo}

SELECT no, visited_date, start_time, end_time, move_time, attraction_title, attraction_thumbnail, attraction_latitude, attraction_longitude, attraction_rating, memo, attraction_no, my_plan_no FROM my_daily_plan WHERE my_plan_no = #{planNo} ORDER BY visited_date ASC, start_time ASC
